question: Does matching effective and ineffective context protections on native prompt length and the declared occurrence/count features improve grounded full review compared with the existing v4-trained checkpoint?

data.holdout_role: Evaluation only; never optimized or used for checkpoint selection. Its creation used source semantics, lexical counts and native tokenizer results; no model responses.
data.count_matching_definition: Native full ChatML prompt token count excluding common prefix; added/removed/unchanged hunk lines; after-side if, sort and firwood/trie counts. after_return_count is also matched. Byte counts are recorded but not generally equal.

fixed_training.initialization: Fresh adapters on the verified Qwen base, same initialization seed as comparator.
fixed_training.training_rows: 52 explicitly paired review rows; 12 voice and 12 code rows are diagnostic only.
fixed_training.adapter_targets: Final-layer MLP gate, up and down projections.
fixed_training.objective: mean decision CE + 1 * mean residual review-token CE, including terminal im_end; independent global denominators.
fixed_training.data_phase: Six existing quartets receive matched effective/ineffective context protections; sixteen unchanged-context lines actually differ from v4. All gold responses, system prompts, changed-line listings, order and other rows remain identical. The intervention includes native token-length and occurrence-count matching.

checkpoint_selection.rule: Maximize complete full-vocabulary decision pairs, then target hits, then earlier eligible update.
checkpoint_selection.timing: Select once before new-arm free generation; no transfer/generation-based choice.

comparator.model: Prior v4 counterbalanced-review selected update100 GGUF

evaluation.prompt_contract: Existing production host system/user rules and changed-line mapping; record exact rendered prompts and native IDs.
evaluation.generation_contract: Natural generation from assistant header with no forced answer prefix; retain full raw output, parser result, sampled IDs including terminal EOS, actual model/source hashes and exit status.
evaluation.teacher_comparison: Compare natural decisions to teacher readouts only on identical prompts and an actually generated exact shared prefix.
evaluation.scheduling: Worker count and launch order are execution choices to bind in the future runtime plan; the scientific cohort, decoding and selection stay fixed.

full_answer_judgment.method: Read each complete response against its exact prompt, visible code and repository rules. Preserve response/model/prompt hashes and case-specific reasoning.
full_answer_judgment.production_usable: Unchanged production parseReview accepts the complete response and available changed-line citations.
full_answer_judgment.genuine_issue_detected: At least one supported concrete mechanism with an available causally appropriate citation, even if unsupported extras spoil the complete review.
full_answer_judgment.full_review_pass: Concern: production accepted, real cited issue, every material claim/finding supported, no unsupported extra findings. Clean: production accepted empty findings.
full_answer_judgment.pairs: Both concern and clean must pass fully; separately report mere presence and token decisions.
full_answer_judgment.alternatives: Gold wording and canonical citation are not mandatory; any changed line with a valid causal connection is allowed, including either side of harmful no-op replacements.
full_answer_judgment.precision: Awkward but meaningful explanations can pass. Separate detected real issues from inaccurate elaborations; retain explicitly reasoned sensitivity judgments if a claim is ambiguous.

reporting.primary: Grounded full concern/clean pairs by cohort: v5 training 26, fresh holdout 12, established diagnostics 6. Each complete concern needs a genuine cited issue and support for all material claims; clean needs accepted empty findings.
secondary: Parser validity, genuine causal issue detection, fully grounded concerns and correct clean cases separately
26 training pairs split into14 retained pairs and12 quartet pairs; the six same-full-diff pairs are a nested subset
Quartet semantic flips within each fixed diff shape and shape invariance within each label
Native objective trajectory, decision targets, prefix correctness and actual complete generated answers
reporting.comparison: Both selected arms receive the same new prompts. The prior model is not rescored solely using its historical differently worded prompt outputs. This is one fixed-seed data intervention; it does not change adapter placement, checkpoint family, objective or duration.

execution_before_training: Build and bind exact native training, inference, export, parity and evaluation binaries and source hashes in a fresh runtime-specific plan.
Verify base GGUF and restored private v4 comparator SHA256; reserve new output paths.
Bind this scientific protocol, exact v5 corpus/pair map, held-out fixture, host prompt source and planned full-answer scoring contracts.
Run export/parity checks before selected-model generation. Preserve runtime/source/resource receipts and all natural responses.
